articles.headline: World Cup live updates: Mexico, England locked in tense battle
articles.description: It's a huge clash for co-hosts Mexico as they take on Thomas Tuchel's England in their 2026 FIFA World Cup round-of-16 match in Mexico City.

articles.headline: Norway coach Solbakken slams Balogun decision as 'bad, bad, bad, bad'
articles.description: Norway coach Solbakken slams Balogun decision as 'bad, bad, bad, bad'

articles.headline: Mexico vs. England at World Cup kicks off an hour late due to severe weather
articles.description: Kick-off in Mexico's round of 16 World Cup match against England was delayed by an hour due to severe weather.

articles.headline: Senegal delegation members still awaiting flight home five days after World Cup elimination - sources
articles.description: Members of the Senegal delegation to the World Cup are still stranded in Seattle awaiting a flight back home, five days after the team were eliminated by Belgium, sources within the camp have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Carlo Ancelotti vows to start 'new cycle' after Brazil's World Cup exit
articles.description: Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti said he's looking to oversee a "new cycle" with the team after they crashed out of the World Cup on Sunday in the round of 16.

articles.headline: Erling Haaland says Brazil win 'greatest game' in Norway history
articles.description: Erling Haaland said his two-goal match-winning performance in Norway's 2-1 World Cup round-of-16 victory against Brazil capped an "insane" day in his country's history -- and its greatest game.
